label: Westermo Lynx 3510-E-F2G2.5-T8G-LV
description: Westermo Lynx 3510-E-F2G2.5-T8G-LV 10-port industrial managed Layer 3 switch/router: 8x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 and 2x 2.5 Gbit/s SFP cages, WeOS Extended routing, 12-48 VDC, -40 to +70 C.
notes: Datasheet 'Lynx 3000 Series_2611_EN_REV.P'. All Lynx 3510 models are the 10-port chassis: 8 copper RJ45 plus 2 SFP cages, in 52 x 134 x 130 mm of full-metal IP40 housing at 1,100 g, DIN-rail or wall mount, -40 to +70 C operating (-40 to +85 C storage), 5-95% RH, 2,000 m altitude, 64 VLANs and 8 priority queues, 5-year warranty. Console is a USB-C port that emulates a serial port at 115200 bps; there is also a Micro SD slot (SD 2.0) and one digital input plus one digital output on screw terminals. Powered by WeOS 5: web UI over HTTP/HTTPS, CLI over console/SSHv2/Telnet, SNMPv1/v2c/v3 read-only MIBs, RADIUS/TACACS+, 802.1X, RSTP, LACP, FRNTv0/v2 and MRP ring recovery, DHCP server/relay/client, NTP, syslog. The datasheet gives no switching-capacity or MAC-table figure, so none is modelled here. Layer 3 (WeOS Extended: static routing, OSPFv2, RIPv1/v2, VRRPv2/v3, NAT/NAPT, stateful firewall) on the 2.5G SFP chassis. Copper is 10/100/1000BASE-T only. 12-48 VDC rated, 9.6-60 VDC operating.
